Dylan/Marissa — thanks for the ping. I've drafted a concise security-exhibit snippet that covers pen testing, SOC 2 access, and evidence delivery. High-level notes first: 

- Pen test: Redwood can permit third-party pen tests against a dedicated staging environment with 14 days' advance notice; tests must be scheduled within a mutually agreed 7-day window. Production testing is allowed only with explicit written approval and limited to non-destructive scans. We propose liability carve-outs and an agreed point of contact for escalation.

- SOC 2: we can provide a persistent read-only link to our SOC 2 report via our document portal for the contract term; alternatively, we will accept a certified auditor access request under NDA.

- Evidence cadence: propose monthly automated extracts of relevant, redacted logs (JSON) and quarterly manual evidence packages (for compliance reviews). Retention commitment: 12 months for audit-specific exports, standard logs retained per our policy (30 days raw, 12 months aggregated).

I attached the snippet (word doc) — feel free to push back on the retention windows or prod/staging language. If Aurelia requires longer retention for specific artifacts we can consider a paid addendum.

Proposed next steps:
1) Marissa confirm operational feasibility for monthly extracts and who on ops will own delivery.
2) Dylan send the snippet to Aurelia with the scheduling options below.

Snippet attached: RDW_proposed-msaredline-snippet.docx

Regards,
Olga Petrov

Samantha — thanks for the clear asks. Below is a short response and the proposed redline language (excerpt) for your team to review. If this looks reasonable we can kick off the scheduling flow.

Proposed redline excerpt (high level):
"Redwood Inference will permit third-party penetration tests against a mutually agreed non-production staging environment during Redwood's published staging access hours with at least fourteen (14) days' prior written notice. Production testing is prohibited except by separate written agreement and shall exclude destructive or denial-of-service techniques. Redwood will provide a read-only link to its current SOC 2 report for the term of the agreement, or allow auditor access under NDA. Operational evidence (redacted logs) will be provided monthly in machine-readable JSON format; a consolidated compliance package will be delivered quarterly within five (5) business days of request. Retention of audit-specific exports shall be no less than twelve (12) months."

Scheduling options for the initial pen-test window:
- Option A: 2026-04-12 to 2026-04-16 (staging)
- Option B: 2026-04-26 to 2026-04-30 (staging)

Can you confirm preferred window and provide the name/email of your primary security contact? Also let us know if Aurelia requires longer retention for any specific artifacts so we can evaluate the addendum route.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
